card.name: Middle initials in names; 'on the' before places
card.fires_on: Middle initials or name parts after a first name (Gerard P., Gordon R., Gerald R.), and 'on' or 'on the' after 'located/built' before a place such as a corner, shore or site.

modes.label: Middle initials
modes.description: The initial or period after a first name and middle letter in a person's full name.

modes.label: Built or located on the
modes.description: The word 'on' or 'the' after 'located' or 'built' when a building or business site is described.

card.writes: It promotes 'corner' words, suggesting a location phrase such as 'on the corner of' may come next.
card.plain: It marks spots in a name's middle initial or in 'built on the' phrases, where a location word like 'corner' might follow.
